cohort: 369 women who had undergone Cesarean Section in three hospitals affiliated with Shiraz University of Medical Sciences, Iran from April 2018 to March 2019
finding: Obstetric characteristics in Robson Classification, including parity, previous C/S, gestational age, onset of labor, fetal presentation, and number of fetuses, were found to be associated with maternal-infant attachment scores.
mod_finding: This study found that obstetric characteristics in the Robson Classification, including parity, previous cesarean section, gestational age, onset of labor, fetal presentation, and number of fetuses, were effective in clarifying information about cesarean section rates.
